import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0062.png')

# Right edge of the side face (which meets the wall/background)
for r in range(335, 512, 10):
    # look along row r for the transition from wood ([116-140, 147-155, 171-175]) to wall ([255, 255, 255]) or floor ([140-160, 150-165, 155-170])
    row = img[r, :, :]

    xs = np.where(wood)[0]
    if len(xs) > 0:
        print(f'r={r}: wood x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}]')
